result:
Post revisions are implemented and verified. `bun run typecheck` passes, and `bun test` runs 7 tests with 0 failures (2 existing plus 5 new). Lint, `guren check` and `guren audit` are also clean.

**How it works**

- **Storage:** a new `post_revisions` table (id, post_id, title, excerpt, body, created_at as ISO text) with a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260925051804_add_post_revisions/`.
- **Keeping versions:** the existing update action now snapshots the post's title, excerpt and body into a revision and applies the edit inside one transaction. Validation and authorization throw before that, so refused edits keep nothing. Creating a post keeps nothing.
- **History page:** `GET /posts/:id/revisions` renders a new Revisions page with `post` and `revisions: [{ id, postId, title, excerpt, body, createdAt }]`, newest first. The post page shows a History link for the author.
- **Restore:** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` snapshots the current version as a new revision, copies the chosen revision back onto the post, and redirects to `/posts/:id`. The restored row stays in the list.
- **Authorization:** two new policy abilities, `viewRevisions` and `restore`, reuse the update rule. Non-authors get 403, guests are redirected to `/login` by the existing auth middleware. A revision id belonging to another post answers 404.
- **Delete:** destroying a post deletes its revisions first, in the same transaction.

**Summary of changes.** Added the `postRevisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with a matching migration, a `PostRevision` model in `app/Models/PostRevision.ts`, a `revisions` has-many relation plus a `snapshotForRevision` helper on `app/Models/Post.ts`, and `viewRevisions`/`restore` abilities in `app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`. `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` now writes a revision on update and clears them on destroy, while the new `app/Http/Controllers/PostRevisionController.ts` serves the list and restore actions, using `app/Http/Resources/PostRevisionResource.ts` and a `PostRevisionParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`. Routes `posts.revisions.index` and `posts.revisions.restore` are registered in `routes/web.ts` inside the auth group; the page lives at `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` with a History link added to `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated, and `tests/PostRevisionController.test.ts` covers the worked example, refused edits, author-only access, guest redirects, the cross-post 404 and delete cleanup.
